The HWPX event announcement automation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a stable integration of the LangChain graph workflow.

While the 3m 58s runtime indicates a heavy processing overhead, the resulting JSON output at /result.json confirms the pipeline is reusable for HWPX document generation.
